about: The wizard-os Hermes plugin at a commit on wizard-agent-service main. WAM renders the wizard-job-* pointer skills with this kernel.py (the same renderer the plugin and the Agent Service use), and `wam fresh-agent connect` installs the plugin into the container Hermes from plugin_source at this commit, then checks the installed files against these sha256 values. tests/test_fresh_agent.py fails when they drift.
